interactions.title: Cloudspinner remembers Amberglow
lines: DM: Lastlight Falls in the fey realm of Amberglow is hidden among rocky cliffs, a place of calm where water cascades from the rocks above to clear—to a clear pool below, the long shadows of sunset spilling across the water. The last light of the day catching the spray and turning it to a glittering rainbow in the empty, desolate realm of Amberglow. This remains one of the few places of color and safety. As a group of travelers gather here, some reunited after long separation, and others newly met, the Cloudspinner feels their presence even from her prison far away, and she drifts in thought.

DM: She remembers the days of plenty in Amberglow when she ruled as the Queen of Sunsets, when the glorious colors of the evening sun turned the sky and the grass and the water and the rocks to ever-changing paintings, when she spun threads of magic and color from the sky. When her court dazzled any who came with her beauty and elegance.

DM: She remembers the fateful day she was tricked, bound, and captive. Her tools stolen, her life constrained, Amberglow slowly falling into ruin. She remembers how she could feel the footsteps of decay, a constant reminder of her fate as the color ran out from Amberglow. Her magnificent Cloud Palace fell into disarray. Her court and servants fled or lost, save the few who hung on in desperation or fear or confusion, slowly turning as pale and colorless as the land itself.

DM: She remembers the darkness that crept over her realm, the cursed ones, the hags and tricksters and malicious spirits of the Unseelie Court who came after she was gone who conquered and claimed Amberglow as their own. Who filled the realm with darkness and despair. She remembers how they hunted down her remaining subjects, and how they desecrated the places that had once held such beauty and light.

DM: She also remembers the resistance, the brave fey and other creatures who fought back, who formed secret alliances and underground networks, who kept the spark of hope alive even in Amberglow's darkest days: Typhina, the protector of the Heartwood Grove. Lirien, the Lady of the Lake, who drained the River of Time. Bellator the Changeling King, who sacrificed himself to hide the ruins of the Cloud Palace from those that would mean harm.

DM: So she watches and waits, and she hopes for the day when she will be free, and when Amberglow will once again be a realm of beauty and wonder. Until then she will continue to dream and hold on to the memory of what once was and what could be again.
DM: And as our story fades from the Cloudspinner and turns now to the travelers, at Lastlight Falls you may yet have a small role to play in the story of Amberglow.
